CustomField.description: Gross Revenue Retention = (Existing MRR - Churn/Contraction MRR) / Existing MRR x 100. Computed as (Existing_MRR__c + Loss_MRR__c) / Existing_MRR__c x 100, where Loss_MRR__c (from the related Opportunity) is already a negative value representing churn/contraction only, excluding expansion. Blank when there is no Existing MRR baseline (e.g. New Business).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Gross Revenue Retention: how much of the prior contract's MRR was kept, excluding any expansion/upsell. Caps at 100% by definition.
CustomField.label: GRR
